verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's first-party developer docs describe webhooks that notify you of account changes via HTTP POST. Payloads are signed with a SHA-256 HMAC in the x-savvycal-signature header, and subscriptions are set up under Settings > Integrations. Webhooks are listed as a core integration method alongside the REST API. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types and payload schemas, retry/delivery-guarantee details, programmatic (API-based) webhook subscription management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
